title: Jahgol Ruuhu Adopted
intro: E jamaanu mo aadaaji renndo njogii doole, neɗɗo keeriiɗo ina heɓa waylo-waylo luggiɗngo e nder galle barkinaaɗo. Daartol maɓɓe, maantinirngol jokkondire giɗli e yamiroore Alla, ina hollita taƴgol aadaaji ɓooyɗi e sosde kuule kese, peewal. Ndee ɗoo tinndinoore ina hollita nafoore goonga e dow nanondiral e hakkille gonɗo caggal jamirooje Alla.
clues: Mi meeɗiino wonde nanngaaɗo, kono e peeje Alla, mi heɓii galle keso e ɓesngu kesu.
Miɗo yiɗaa no feewi haa nde ndokkaa-mi suɓaade hakkunde galle am jibinaaɗo e gardiiɗo am jibinaaɗo, mi suɓii ko heddaade e ɗiɗaɓo oo.
Innde am meeɗiino jokkondirde e gardotooɗo am, ko huunde heewnde waɗeede e nder renndo am.
Ko miin tan woni sehil Annabi cakkitiiɗo mo innde mum siftinaa e nder Quraan.
Mi resii debbo tedduɗo ko banndi Nelaaɗo, kono dewgal amen duumaaki.
Caggal ceergal am, Alla e hoore mum yamiri yo debbo am gonnooɗo oo res Nelaaɗo, ɗum noon ina bonni aada ɓooyɗo jowitiiɗo e ƴettugol.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Yamiroore Alla ko faati e dewgal am e ceergal am
trial.answer: Yamiroore Alla ko faati e dewgal am e ceergal am

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Mumtugol gollal hade lislaam ‘noddude ɓiɓɓe jibinaaɓe ko ɓiɓɓe biologique’.
outcome.answer: Mumtugol gollal hade lislaam ‘noddude ɓiɓɓe jibinaaɓe ko ɓiɓɓe biologique’.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
